method: Three new maintenance tasks frozen before graph predictions. Source review followed registered project paths, recent Git filenames, and named guides; no recursive discovery and at most six distinct files read per repository. Positive targets are partial required sets, not complete relevance labels.

flutter-forge.reason: Recent shared PopupScope introduction, separate from theme/window and BLE cases.

gcode-core.reason: Android host metadata and packaged API/ABI enforcement, separate from parser/GPU progress and runtime evidence cases.

flutterguard.reason: Baseline creation and stable issue fingerprint path handling, separate from scan stdout, rule registry and IDEA adapter cases.

cases.query_zh: 维护共享弹出层的资源所有权：关闭整组浮层时同时清理遮罩，页面退出只移除自己创建的弹窗路由；同一通道重新开始或关闭后立即取消延迟打开队列。
cases.query_en: Maintain shared popup resource ownership: closeOverlay removes its whole group including modal barriers, dispose removes only owned routes, and replacing a sequence channel immediately cancels delayed opens.
cases.rationale: The scoped machine contract owns overlay_group_lifecycle and cancellable_sequences; PopupScope implements keyed routes, owned overlay groups, channel tokens, pauses, and deferred route removal on disposal.

cases.query_zh: 检查安卓示例宿主的图形能力开关与产物契约是否一致：应用级启用 Flutter GPU，最低 API 29 且只允许 ARM64；持续集成必须检查打包后 APK 的最低系统版本和 ABI。这里只核对配置，不声明设备运行验收。
cases.query_en: Check Android example host and artifact contracts: enable Flutter GPU in application metadata, require minSdk 29 and arm64-v8a only, and keep CI packaged APK min-sdk and ABI verification consistent with Gradle.
cases.rationale: The manifest declares application-level EnableFlutterGPU; Gradle fixes minSdk 29 and sole arm64-v8a ABI; CI verifies min-sdk with apkanalyzer and APK lib ABI inventory. Those are configuration/build facts only.

cases.query_zh: 维护基线创建与匹配的一致性：创建基线时采集未抑制的原始发现，按解析后的项目目录处理相对输出路径；问题指纹采用项目相对路径并统一路径分隔符，去重排序后写入基线。
cases.query_en: Maintain baseline create and matching consistency: collect unsuppressed rawIssues, resolve relative output under the scanned project root, normalize project-relative separators in Baseline fingerprints, and encode sorted unique fingerprints.

ownership_expectation.rationale: The CLI routes arguments/output, delegates scan to the kernel and fingerprints to Baseline; source ownership is adapter even though it imports dart:io for command I/O.

cases.rationale: BaselineCommands.create passes applySuppression:false and serializes result.rawIssues, while Baseline.fingerprint shares path normalization with contains and encode sorts unique fingerprints.

limitations: Holdout tasks are independent additions frozen before predictions, but all are from the same three local worktrees; this is not a generalization claim across new repositories.
must_hit is a partial required path set and cannot measure precision.
Only explicit rule-target expectations and actual returned target files establish pair coverage; source existence is never used to remove expected denominator entries.
No semantic platform acceptance or release readiness is scored.
